name: HiveMind
notes: Speech-to-text works with no signal on phones that can, and hears bee words and your hive names right the first time.
What you say in an inspection is recorded with it: play it back, and tap words the phone wasn't sure of (underlined) to hear them again.
A Bluetooth earpiece is used as the microphone automatically. A level bar shows you're being heard, and it warns when wind drowns you out.
A buzz when it starts and stops listening. Settings › Listening has the switches.
Saying "no honey" no longer offers to log a harvest of 0.
